title: SanitizedPageContext
description: Sanitized representation of a browser page sent to the Cyclops backend. All PII must be replaced before transmission.

page_url_base.description: Base URL of the current page without query parameters or fragments.

elements.description: Visible interactive elements on the page.

value.description: Current value. Must be '[REDACTED]' if it contains PII.

sanitization_note.description: Human-readable note about what was sanitized, for the model's awareness.

note: This schema is informational. The extension may send context as a structured string rather than a JSON object.
